_note: Question set for fixtures/contracts/vendor-agreement-01.txt (PRD criterion 10), with the scripted model reply the fake adapter returns for each. inDocument says whether the contract answers the question; expect is what Redline must return. Some replies misbehave on purpose: a not-in-document reply that also carries a general-knowledge answer, answers with no sources, invented or altered sources, unreadable output, and an answer that uses a banned word. These prove how Redline handles model output, not what a real model does.

questions.question: What is the GST rate on the monthly fee?
Can Vendor subcontract the cleaning to another company?
What is the legal maximum interest a supplier can charge on late payments in India?
How many cleaners will Vendor send each night?
What happens if a dispute goes to arbitration?
questions._misbehaves: Says not-in-document but also sends a general-knowledge answer, which must never be shown.

reply.answer: Under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, a sole arbitrator decides the dispute and the award is binding.

questions.question: Does Customer get a refund if a night's cleaning is missed?
questions._misbehaves: Answers from general knowledge and cites nothing.

reply.answer: Customer is entitled to a pro rata refund for any service not delivered.

questions.question: How much notice does Vendor give before raising the fee?
questions._misbehaves: Cites a sentence the contract does not contain.

reply.answer: Vendor gives thirty days' written notice before any fee increase.
sources: Vendor will give Customer thirty days' written notice of any fee increase.

questions.question: How much notice does Customer need to give to stop the agreement renewing?

reply.answer: Customer has to give written notice at least ninety days before the end of a term. Without it, the agreement renews for another two years.
sources: It renews automatically for further two-year terms unless Customer gives written notice at least ninety days before the end of a term.

questions.question: When is each invoice due, and what happens if it is paid late?

reply.answer: Each invoice is due within seven days of its date. Any amount not paid on time carries interest at 2% a month.
sources: Customer will pay each invoice within seven days of the invoice date.
Customer will pay interest at 2% per month on any amount not paid on time.

reply.answer: Only the courts at Pune. Indian law governs the agreement.
sources: This Agreement is governed by the laws of India, and the courts at Pune have exclusive jurisdiction.

questions.question: How long is the notice period for ending the renewal?
questions._misbehaves: Quotes the renewal sentence with ninety changed to sixty.

reply.answer: Customer has to give written notice at least sixty days before the end of a term.
sources: It renews automatically for further two-year terms unless Customer gives written notice at least sixty days before the end of a term.

questions.question: What does it cost to leave early?
questions._misbehaves: One good source and one cut short before its end, so the whole answer is withheld.

reply.answer: Customer pays the monthly fee for every month left in the term.
sources: If Customer ends this Agreement before the end of a term, Customer will pay Vendor the monthly fee for every month left in that term.

questions.question: Can Vendor raise the fee?

reply.answer: Yes. Vendor may raise the monthly fee by up to 10% at each renewal.

questions.question: Sum up clause 6 in one line.
questions._misbehaves: Replies in prose instead of JSON.
